11869-venetia.title: Venetia
11869-venetia.creator: Unknown
11869-venetia.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This picturesque and secluded abode was the residence of Lady Annabel Herbert and her daughter, the young and beautiful Venetia, a child, at the time when our history commences, of very tender age. It was nearly seven years since Lady Annabel and her infant daughter had sought the retired shades of Cherbury, which they had never since quitted.

arxiv-2104-12411.title: Neutral vs Ion Linewidths in Barnard 5: Evidence for Penetration by MHD Waves Journal: ApJ Aplpy ( Robitaille & Bressert 2012 ; Robitaille 2019 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , pyspec
arxiv-2104-12411.creator: Jaime E. Pineda, Anika Schmiedeke, Paola Caselli, Steven W. Stahler, David T. Frayer, Sarah E. Church, Andrew I. Harris
arxiv-2104-12411.description: Abstract Dense cores are the final place where turbulence is dissipated. It has been proposed from theoretical arguments that the non-thermal velocity dispersion should be narrower both for molecular ions (compared to neutrals) and for transitions with higher critical densities.

arxiv-2305-04442.title: Controlling superconducting transistor by coherent light
arxiv-2305-04442.creator: Guo-Jian Qiao, Zhi-Lei Zhang, Sheng-Wen Li, C. P. Sun
arxiv-2305-04442.description: Abstract The Josephson junction is typically tuned by a magnetic field or electrostatic gates to realize a superconducting transistor, which manipulates the supercurrent in integrated superconducting circuits. However, this tunable method does not achieve simultaneous control for the supercurrent phase (phase difference between two superconductors) and magnitude.

arxiv-2305-09669.title: SHATTER: Control and Defense-Aware Attack Analytics for Activity-Driven Smart Home Systems
arxiv-2305-09669.creator: Nur Imtiazul Haque 1 , Maurice Ngouen 1 , Mohammad Ashiqur Rahman 1 , Selcuk Uluagac 2 , and Laurent Njilla 3
arxiv-2305-09669.description: Abstract Modern smart home control systems utilize real-time occupancy and activity monitoring to ensure control efficiency, occupants’ comfort, and optimal energy consumption. Moreover, adopting machine learning-based anomaly detection models (ADMs) enhances security and reliability. However, sufficient system knowledge allows adversaries/attackers to alter sensor measurements through stealthy false data injection (FDI) attacks.

arxiv-2306-11014.title: Physics Constrained Unsupervised Deep Learning for Rapid, High Resolution Scanning Coherent Diffraction Reconstruction
arxiv-2306-11014.creator: Oliver Hoidn, Aashwin Ananda Mishra, Apurva Mehta
arxiv-2306-11014.description: Abstract By circumventing the resolution limitations of optics, coherent diffractive imaging (CDI) and ptychography are making their way into scientific fields ranging from X-ray imaging to astronomy. Yet, the need for time consuming iterative phase recovery hampers real-time imaging. While supervised deep learning strategies have increased reconstruction speed, they sacrifice image quality.

pmc-10473262.title: A pattern of cognitive resource disruptions in childhood psychopathology
pmc-10473262.creator: Andrew J Stier, Carlos Cardenas-Iniguez, Omid Kardan, Tyler M Moore, Francisco A C Meyer, Monica D Rosenberg, Antonia N Kaczkurkin, Benjamin B Lahey, Marc G Berman
pmc-10473262.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The Hurst exponent (H) isolated in fractal analyses of neuroimaging time series is implicated broadly in cognition. Within this literature, H is associated with multiple mental disorders, suggesting that H is transdimensionally associated with psychopathology. Here, we unify these results and demonstrate a pattern of decreased H with increased general psychopathology and attention-deficit/hyperactivity factor scores during a working memory task in 1,839 children. This pattern predicts current and future cognitive performance in children and some psychopathology in 703 adults.

pmc-11481600.title: Comprehensive analysis of a necroptosis-associated diagnostic signature for myelodysplastic syndromes based on single-cell RNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq
pmc-11481600.creator: Huimin Zhang, Li Zhang, Xiaoning Liang, Lihong Zhang, Bing Ma, Yuexian Li, Jianying Wang, Yang Shen, Yuhui Pang, Jianjun Xiong
pmc-11481600.description: BackgroundMyelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) are heterogeneous and clonal hematological disorders. The role and mechanism of necroptosis in MDS remain poorly understood.MethodsmRNA expression profiles and single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data were sourced from the GEO database. ScRNA-seq data were processed using the “Seurat” package. After cell annotation, necroptosis-related scores (NRscores) for each cell were calculated using the “UCell” package.

pmc-12968223.title: Predatory marketing and false health promotion on social media: risk pathways in diet, fitness, and supplement communication
pmc-12968223.creator: Youjing Huang, Xinchen Leng, Zirong Tian
pmc-12968223.description: As the commercial circulation of health content on social media continues to intensify, large volumes of fitness, nutrition, and wellness information lacking scientific grounding are repeatedly pushed to users, heightening the likelihood that psychologically susceptible individuals internalize distorted beliefs and engage in harmful practices.

pmc-12999708.title: A flexible automated magnetic microrobot assembly system
pmc-12999708.creator: Oliver J Shindell, Aaron C Davis, David J Cappelleri
pmc-12999708.description: This paper presents a novel system for flexible automated fabrication of microrobots with embedded permanent magnets, and for the loading of liquid therapeutic drugs and sealing with thermally sensitive wax. Microrobots featuring embedded magnets are more controllable and observable, and are capable of tasks requiring higher forces.

pmc-13111631.title: hERG epitope mimic-decoy peptide corrects autoimmune-long QT syndrome in guinea pigs
pmc-13111631.creator: Michael Cupelli, Vamsi Krishna Murthy Ginjupalli, Jean-Baptiste Reisqs, Yvonne Sleiman, Manuel Becerra-Flores, Riccardo Accioli, Pietro Enea Lazzerini, Timothy Cardozo, Mohamed Boutjdir
pmc-13111631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe most investigated form of autoimmune-long-QT-syndrome (LQTS) is caused by circulating anti-Ro/SSA(Sjögren’s syndrome-related antigen-A)-52kD antibodies, which cross-react with a specific sequence of the human ether-à-go-go-related (hERG) potassium channel’s pore region, reducing the rapid inward-rectifying potassium current (IKr) density.

pmc-13471384.creator: Ye Li, Yuqi Xu, Qi Ren, Zeyu Pan, Fan Shi, Pengxia Wan
pmc-13471384.description: PurposeTo investigate the relationship between pupillary response and diabetic characteristics in cataract patients and explore whether impaired pupillary function may impact cataract surgical outcomes and visual recovery in diabetic patients.MethodsThis prospective study included 362 participants (133 diabetic patients and 229 controls) who underwent cataract surgery.
